info.title: EMCORE Central API Gateway
info.description:
Central ingress edge router and unified reverse proxy for all EMCORE enterprise domain APIs and backend-for-frontend gateways. Provides rate limiting, correlation tracking, TLS termination, header sanitization, and centralized API contract discovery.

**Service Ownership:** Platform Infrastructure & Edge Team
**Intended Consumers:** All external public, mobile, portal, and partner consumers
**Operational Mode:** Primarily synchronous HTTP API; critical domain mutations emit versioned outbox events and may operate under eventual consistency.
**Confidentiality:** Public/Enterprise Consumer Contract.
